items.title: Fortinet (FTNT) Raises Revenue Outlook After Strong Q2 And New AI Product Push
items.summary: Fortinet raised its annual revenue forecast after reporting strong Q2 results that exceeded its prior guidance on revenue and profitability. The company highlighted progress in its shift to a subscription led model and deeper use of generative AI across its product suite. Fortinet announced a collaboration with Intel on the Fortinet Security Processor 6 and rolled out new offerings including FortiGate 1200G and FortiSOC. items.title: Fortinet lifts annual revenue forecast on strong cybersecurity demand
items.summary: Cybersecurity firm Fortinet on Wednesday lifted its annual revenue forecast after ‌reporting strong second-quarter results, signaling strong enterprise ‌spending on its services amid rising data security incidents. Companies are ​ramping up data security budgets to tackle increasingly sophisticated ransomware attacks and other threats. The California-based company now projects annual revenue between $8.02 billion and $8.18 billion, ‌compared with its ⁠previous expectation of $7.71 billion to $7.87 billion.
